base_protocol.arrival_model: independent Poisson arrivals per second; common tape across budgets
base_protocol.dispatch: global synchronous frames; released jobs only; FIFO within class
base_protocol.score: queue weighted actual frame departures divided by actual frame duration
base_protocol.budget_unit: candidate construction or feasibility attempt; seeds included
base_protocol.stopping_rule: stop arrivals at horizon, then drain the same finite prefix

protocol.changed_rule: replace fixed-spacing arrivals by one shared sampled Poisson path per active comparison; all current search, recovery, support floors and terminal integration stay fixed
protocol.arrival_path: class-specific exponential gaps at registered lambda, accumulated from decision time 0 to the common H; one path generated and shared by two contenders
protocol.rng: per-class random.Random('aligned-planning:{planning_seed}:{coordinate}'), distinct from exogenous aligned-frame streams; each complete run starts fresh and active decisions advance it; no Q-based caching or reseeding
protocol.rng_scope: same planning seed crossed with every real arrival seed, load and K; planning state is local to each run and never supplied a real arrival tape or real arrival seed
protocol.random_cost: charge every exponential draw, including first beyond H; zero-rate classes make no draw; report RNG initialization count and setup time separately
protocol.objective: same complete first-frame plus two pure-batch successor areas and remaining shared-population fluid tail; no old Poisson correction added
protocol.budget: one shared sample and exactly two paid successor frames per contender; three planning repetitions are separate full runs, never three free paths in one decision
protocol.sampling_limits: single-path argmin is not an expected-cost minimizer; fluid tail and analytic challenger restriction remain
protocol.known_counterexample: describe all three fresh planning streams on the previously observed (1,4,8); no requirement to correct its ordering
protocol.controls: full-K v4, full-K analytic lookahead and frozen midpoint-arrival rollout; reproduce all 108 old control runs
protocol.reference: v4 K120 remains the exact support reference
protocol.aggregation: pair each planning repetition against the same real-seed controls; average the three repetitions within each real arrival seed before averaging the original three seeds; report every planning-seed mean and raw range, select none
protocol.stopping_rule: all 216 cases once: 108 controls plus 108 Poisson runs; no seed selection or changes to sampling, horizon, terminal rule or budget after outcomes

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

certificates.arrival_model: independent Poisson job arrivals in physical time
certificates.drift_bound: E[Delta V | Q] <= B + tau_max*C - tau_min*effective_slack*sum(Q)
certificates.capacity_basis: lanes times convex hull of all admitted lane requirements/max(1,duration)

known_counterexample.role: static diagnostic using a fresh planning stream per repetition; no guarantee of the same stream position in a full run; previous realized effects belong to frozen common-v4 continuation

limitations: Each decision uses one sampled path; choosing the cheaper of two noisy costs can be optimistic, and no expected-cost optimality is certified.
Only two successor frames per contender are discrete; the remaining continuation is a fixed-rate fluid approximation and only the original analytic challenger can compete.
Planning repetitions are crossed with the same three reused arrival seeds, not additional independent environments; shared-worker timing is descriptive.
